faces.oracleText:
Creatures can't attack planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1} for each of those creatures.
+1: Up to one target artifact or creature loses all abilities until your next turn.

+2: Up to one target creature gains all creature types. (This effect doesn't end.)

faces.name: Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
faces.oracleText:
